title: Spicy Smoky Lentil Tagine
description: A twist on the traditional Moroccan tagine, this Chinese-inspired dish combines the flavors of smoky and spicy with the comforting texture of lentils.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add cumin powder and chili flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils, tagine spice mix, and 2 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add coconut milk and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with smoky almonds.
